name: Dayflow
description:
Days Flow is a smart, simple, and modern To-Do List app designed to help you organize your daily life and achieve your goals.

Create tasks, set deadlines, manage your schedule, and track your progress — all in one place.

Whether you're managing schoolwork, personal goals, or everyday responsibilities, Days Flow helps you stay focused, organized, and productive.

Key Features:

Create and manage daily tasks.

Set deadlines and reminders.

Track completed tasks.

Organize your daily schedule.

Stay focused and boost productivity.
